name: Jacquemus
why: Sculptural, sun-drenched clothing in a Provençal palette; the men's line is the smaller part.
origin: Founded in 2009 by Simon Porte Jacquemus at 19; named for his mother.

onething.n: Jacquemus attaches to collections and to bags, and the menswear changes shape every season without a garment recurring. Le Chouchou is a show, not a model

notes.style: Sculptural shapes and a Provençal palette; the designer's vision is the brand.
notes.craft: The French Jacquemus product pages give a country of make ('Pays de fabrication : Portugal' on the two shirts that rendered) and composition, with a traceability tab. No maker, mill or owned workshop is named, and the site has no page about how or where things are made. That is a 2. [audit proposed 2 at low confidence; held at 2 pending a second read]

cities: 3 stores — Montecito, New York, West Hollywood · department stores, and its own site

marks: Nothing. Zero named fabric, membrane, insulation or branded-fibre technologies, licensed or house, across the men's line, and zero trademark symbols of any kind. The only term-list matches are two unnamed generic descriptors: 'technical fabric' on 4 products (windbreakers and the Curvo jacket - 'Tex

T-shirt.hp: The Soie t-shirt (100% silk jersey, short sleeve)

craft_evidence.owned_d: No page about making or ateliers was found. The footer lists only legal, customer-service and FAQ links (plus 'Slavery Act'), and the sitemaps hold no maison, savoir-faire or CSR page. No owned factory or workshop is named anywhere I reached.
craft_evidence.countries: Portugal 2/2 where the field rendered (fr_fr PDPs: la chemise Camargue, la chemise Gardian - 'Pays de fabrication : Portugal'). 2 further fr_fr shirt PDPs (Nappe, Jean Atelier) and 2 en_gb PDPs returned no product details at all (JS-rendered/collapsed), so treat 'some' as a floor, not a measured share. The sample is shirts only; no other category's PDP was reached.
